Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 115. Category: feat. Trained Feature Feats.

Requires Complete Ultra Ego
When you would transform into any Form that has:
Ultra Ego in its name, it now costs 1 less stamina to
transform and to upkeep with a minimum of 1.
Additionally, you gain an additional Destruction Die at
the end of your turn.
